means.example-sentence: The city gradually began to take control of the situation after the damage by the flood.
means.sentence-jp: 市は次第に洪水の被害後の状況を制御し始めた。

cloze.maskedText: The city gradually began to ____ the situation after the damage by the flood.

notes: lose control of ~『〜を制御[管理・支配]できなくなる』。
take の代わりに gain, get, have なども使う。
under control は『制御[抑制]されて』、out of control は『制御しきれなくなって』。
